Each <div class="qb-q"> is one question. question = qb-scenario + constraint-block + qb-ask text, in that order, separated by blank lines (strip tags, decode HTML entities like "). Choices are the <li> items of <ol class="qb-opts" type="A"> in order -> A, B, C, D, E. answer from 'Answer: X' in qb-verdict. explanation = qb-why text + each qb-distractors <li>, verbatim. 'Select two' in qb-head sets select_count. The D-code in qb-head (e.g. D3) goes in source_section exactly as written. heading = qb-num (e.g. Q1).
